data.name: BankConnection.Help
data.value: Link the company's bank account: its transactions arrive here automatically, with no file to download. You give your consent on your bank's own page; Lettra only sees the transactions, never your credentials, and cannot make any payment.

data.name: BankConnection.Revoked
data.value: {0} is disconnected. Transactions already read are kept.

data.name: BankConnection.Callback.Working
data.value: Saving the consent and reading the transactions…

data.name: BankConnection.Simulated.Title
data.value: Allow Lettra to view your account

data.name: BankConnection.Simulated.Intro
data.value: Lettra asks for read-only access to your business current account, through its licensed bank aggregator (EU PSD2 directive).

data.name: BankConnection.Simulated.Duration
data.value: For 180 days, revocable at any time

data.name: BankConnection.Simulated.NoPayment
data.value: No transfer or payment possible with this access

data.name: BankConnection.Simulated.Hint
data.value: Demo: no real bank is contacted. A real bank would ask you to sign in here.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.Unavailable
data.value: No bank aggregator is configured on this installation: import the bank statement instead.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.InstitutionUnknown
data.value: Choose a bank from the list.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.NotFound
data.value: This linked account cannot be found in this company file.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.NotActive
data.value: This account is not linked: consent was not given, or it was disconnected.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.AlreadyCompleted
data.value: The consent for this connection was already recorded.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.ConsentRefused
data.value: Consent was declined or abandoned on the bank's page.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.ConsentExpired
data.value: The consent given to the bank has expired: renew it to read the account.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.SyncInProgress
data.value: This account is already being read. Try again in a moment.

data.name: Error.BankConnection.BankUnreachable
data.value: The bank did not answer. The next sync will try again.
